title: Living Through History
description: A planned experiment in learning from a historical timeline without seeing the future.
body: I want to place a learning system at the beginning of a historical timeline and reveal information only when it would have become available at the time. The initial environment I plan to use is the financial market from roughly 1900 onwards. The objective is not simply to predict prices. I want to study what happens when a system must make decisions, maintain a view of the world, revise earlier beliefs, and continue learning without access to future information.
